clue.text: A vessel does when about to tilt

indicators.note: about here means going round, so the first piece wraps the second

parts.note: does are female deer, so the plural noun gives DEER
to cant is to tilt or slope

explanation.surface: Something odd happens to a vessel when it is about to tip over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'does' looks like a verb but is the plural of doe; 'about' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: A decanter is a glass container for serving wine, a kind of vessel.

clue.text: Opportunity arises in high-lying country

indicators.note: in a down clue, arising means the word reads from the bottom upwards

parts.note: room, as in 'room for improvement', means scope or opportunity

explanation.surface: A chance comes along in the uplands.
explanation.definitionFit: Moorland is open, usually elevated, uncultivated ground, so it is upland country.

clue.text: Isaac's mum turned up on Sunday to be troublesome

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed after, below the first piece
in a down clue, turned up means the name is written bottom to top

parts.note: in the Bible Sarah is the mother of Isaac

explanation.surface: A biblical mother appears on a Sunday and causes trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reverses SARAH to HARAS, and 'on' puts S beneath it.
explanation.definitionFit: To harass someone is to keep bothering them, being a persistent nuisance.

clue.text: Have a cigarette in shelter of the greenery

indicators.note: in places the first pieces inside the shelter word

parts.note: the lee is the sheltered side, away from the wind
fag is British slang for a cigarette

explanation.surface: An invitation to smoke under cover among the plants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' signals the container; fag is everyday British slang for a cigarette.
explanation.definitionFit: Leafage means foliage, the mass of leaves on plants, which is greenery.

clue.text: Admonition for salesman having a bit of a spliff

parts.note: rep, short for representative, is a travelling salesman
a roach is the end or filter of a cannabis joint

explanation.surface: A salesman is told off for sharing a joint.
explanation.definitionFit: A reproach is a rebuke or expression of disapproval, the same as an admonition.

clue.text: A sceptical attitude is time-saving, oddly enough

indicators.note: oddly suggests the letters come out in a strange order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone claims doubting everything saves time.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of TIMESAVING are rearranged; 'oddly' does not mean odd letters here.
explanation.definitionFit: Negativism is a habit of doubt and denial, a sceptical or contrary outlook.

clue.text: Spoil lake popular for fish

parts.note: to mar is to spoil or damage
L is the abbreviation for lake on maps
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: Ruining a lake that is popular with anglers.
explanation.definitionFit: The marlin is a large ocean game fish with a spear-like snout.

clue.text: Set off for school in time

indicators.note: in places the school inside the time word

parts.note: a date is a point in time
Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: Someone leaves for school during term time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' signals the container; Eton is a famous English boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: To set off an explosive is to detonate it, an idiom meaning trigger.

clue.text: Medical procedure shown in hygiene manual

indicators.note: shown in means the letters are displayed within the following words

explanation.surface: A medical treatment described in a hygiene handbook.
explanation.definitionFit: An enema is a medical treatment injecting fluid into the bowel.

clue.text: Just fine

definitions.meaning: fine as weather that is dry and pleasant

explanation.surface: Merely good enough.
explanation.definitionFit: Fair means equitable, and fair weather is fine weather; the surface reads as 'merely okay'.

clue.text: A car in fabrication is inexpensive

indicators.note: in places the car inside the story word

parts.note: a fable is an invented story, a fabrication
a Ford is a make of car

explanation.surface: A car built in a factory turns out cheap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fabrication' suggests manufacturing but means a made-up story; 'in' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Something affordable is within one's means, so not expensive.

clue.text: Goes on about Tory leaders in disagreement

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: to add is to go on, continuing to say more

indicators.note: leaders points to the opening letters of the following word

explanation.surface: A politician rambles on about the heads of the Tory party being at loggerheads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaders' here takes two opening letters, not one; 'about' signals the container. Tories are Britain's Conservatives.
explanation.definitionFit: Two parties at variance are in conflict, an idiom for disagreeing.

clue.text: Dead woman said to be heartbroken

parts.note: Eva is a woman's name
stated means said

explanation.surface: A dead woman is reported to be grief-stricken.
explanation.definitionFit: Devastated means overwhelmed with grief or shock, much like a broken heart.

clue.text: An inclination to stop working in the allotment

indicators.note: in places the stopping word inside the allotment word

parts.note: a grant is an allotment, something allocated
a machine that dies stops working

explanation.surface: Someone is inclined to give up gardening on their allotment plot.
explanation.walkthrough: An allotment in Britain is a rented garden plot, but here it simply means something allocated; 'in' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: A gradient is a slope, and an incline or inclination is a slope.

clue.text: Sextet entering competition that's inconsequential

indicators.note: entering means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a trial is a test or contest of ability
VI is the Roman numeral six, a sextet's number

explanation.surface: A group of six entering a contest that does not matter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sextet' suggests musicians but just gives the number six; 'entering' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Trivial means of little importance or significance.

clue.text: Old tray I renovated with skill

indicators.note: something renovated is remade, so these letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone skilfully restores an antique tray.
explanation.definitionFit: Adroitly means deftly or cleverly, done with dexterity.

clue.text: Mum's cooked liver is to dry up

parts.note: mum's the word means keep quiet, which SH demands

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are altered or fiddled, so rearranged

explanation.surface: Mother's cooked liver is going to dry out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mum' is not mother but silence, SH; 'cooked' rearranges LIVER to RIVEL.
explanation.definitionFit: To shrivel is to wither and shrink as moisture is lost.

clue.text: Lofty is glad about English victory

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the happy word goes around

parts.note: elated means very happy

explanation.surface: Someone tall is pleased about an English win.
explanation.definitionFit: Elevated means high up or raised, the same as lofty.

clue.text: Exploding grenade creates disorder

definitions.note: a verb phrase, matching the verb in sense

indicators.note: something exploding is blown apart, so the letters scatter into a new order

explanation.surface: A grenade going off causes chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: To derange is to throw into confusion or upset the order of things.

clue.text: Jam Penny set aside

parts.note: to reserve is to set aside

explanation.surface: Penny puts a jar of jam aside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Penny' looks like a woman's name but gives P.
explanation.definitionFit: Preserve is a fruit spread, a synonym for jam.

clue.text: Drove detectives off

parts.note: ran means drove, as in ran someone to the station
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police

explanation.surface: Detectives drove away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' looks like part of 'drove off' but is the definition: food gone bad.
explanation.definitionFit: Butter or milk that is off has spoiled and smells rotten.

clue.text: Discourage study about a politician

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the study word goes around

parts.note: a den is a private room for study
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Studying a politician puts you off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'study' is the room, not the activity; 'about' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: To dampen enthusiasm is to deflate it, an idiom for discouraging.

clue.text: Chaperone expected girl to be upset

parts.note: due means expected, as a due train

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A chaperone predicts a young woman will be annoyed.
explanation.definitionFit: A duenna is an older woman who escorts and supervises a young woman, a chaperone.

clue.text: Make it appear false? The patient scoffed!

parts.note: an invalid is someone ill, a patient
scoffed means ate greedily

explanation.surface: A sick person wolfed food down, and someone calls it a lie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scoffed' seems to mean mocked but means ate greedily, in British slang.
explanation.definitionFit: To invalidate an argument is to show it to be unsound or void, demonstrating it false.

clue.text: Try to get publicity to provoke

parts.note: a go is an attempt or try
an ad, an advertisement, is publicity

explanation.surface: Trying to get attention in order to stir people up.
explanation.definitionFit: To goad is to prod or spur someone into action, to provoke.

clue.text: Cut free

definitions.meaning: a cut as a noun: a long deep wound
free in the sense of spare or not in use, British slang

explanation.surface: Released at no charge.
explanation.walkthrough: Gash is British slang for spare or surplus.
explanation.definitionFit: A gash is a deep wound, and gash in slang means spare, available.

clue.text: One understanding perfection

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a deal is an agreement, an understanding

explanation.surface: Someone who grasps what perfection means.
explanation.definitionFit: An ideal is a standard of flawlessness, a model of excellence.

clue.text: Tough German conceals apprehension

indicators.note: conceals means one piece hides inside the other

parts.note: angst is anxiety, apprehension

explanation.surface: A hard-nosed German hides his worries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tough' reads as an adjective but is the noun: a thug. 'conceals' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: A tough is a violent ruffian, and a mobster is that kind of criminal.
